comment: GATE_LEN_PARAM is configured with the unit " sec" at src/SDOrcasHeartV2.cpp:373, but updateParameters at src/SDOrcasHeartV2.cpp:446 multiplies the knob value by the step time before use, so the knob is a fraction of a step rather than a number of seconds; the control's line says so. SPEED is a 0..3 parameter displayed as BPM through a display base of 4 and a multiplier of 32 (src/SDOrcasHeartV2.cpp:361), which gives 32 BPM at the left and 2048 BPM at the right. The two polyphonic modulation jacks are given eight channels (src/SDOrcasHeartV2.cpp:706 and 707) although MODOUTPUTCOUNT is 4, so four of the eight modulation voices can be reached only through the polyphonic cable. updateSyncedParameters is called only on a step (src/SDOrcasHeartV2.cpp:616), which is why the voice count, both algorithm values, the shift, the space and the rotation take effect at the next clock rather than at once. The twenty-four note buttons carry no lettering on the panel; their names come from configSwitch at src/SDOrcasHeartV2.cpp:212 to 225, and the panel prints only A and B beside the two rows. The maker's wiki (https://github.com/scanner-darkly/eightfold/wiki/Orca's-Heart-v2) agrees with the code everywhere it was checked, apart from being silent on the gate length unit.
